title: Store line: a struct's missing field is reported before trailing characters (OQ-136 follow-up)
description: Oracle: a store line `{"id":"proj-a1"} X` is refused with `Invalid JSON at line 1: missing field `title` at line 1 column 16` (exit 7): serde_json deserializes the object and checks its required fields when the object closes, BEFORE it looks for trailing characters. The port reports `trailing characters at line 1 column 18` first (before 2026-09-24 it said `expected value`, also wrong). Fix: in the store decoder (port/core/decode.bend, json.bend members), defer the trailing-characters verdict of the members split until the record's field checks have run. Add a case with a hand-written fixture (e.g. `error_jsonl_missing_then_trailing`), capture, amend S2.27. Found by the OQ-136 probe battery (scratch mb/raw.jsonl).
close_reason: Store-line error order repaired (member error, then missing member at the closing brace, then trailing characters); 4 cases captured, floored STABLE; 1327/1327 on c-1t, c-8t, js; S2.27 amended

title: Quantified laws the spec names (label normalization, count conservation, comparator orders)
description:
Why: of 61 laws only the scaffold's `fast_is_spec` is quantified; the other 60 are closed facts about one value each, so the law side of the project's two equivalences is mostly unbuilt. What: state and prove, over all inputs: label normalization is idempotent; the `count --by-*` groups sum to the total; each list comparator is a total order. Keep the checker's cost in mind: no law may make it normalize a large Peano Nat (a biased Nat OOM-killed PROOF at 16 GB on 2026-09-23). Done when: the laws are proved and cited on the parity board.

Context: beads_bend ports `br --no-db` (the pinned br 0.6.0 release binary is the oracle) to Bend 2.0.20. Evidence is of two kinds only: goldens (the original's captured bytes, compared on every lane) and laws (`port/LAWS.bend`, checked by `bend port/PROOF.bend` -> `All terms check.`). Read AGENTS.md and docs/PORT_STATE.md first. The original runs only through `scripts/ws-run.sh --oracle br --no-db ::`; goldens are captured by `scripts/golden-capture.sh --repin`, never typed; `port/LAWS.bend` is add-only.

Source: docs/BACKLOG.md section H (reality check, 2026-09-23).

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: 2026-09-25 feasibility check against the pinned Base (bend 2.0.20): count conservation needs U32 addition's associativity ((n+1)+t == (n+t)+1 in the tally induction), and Base proves only U32.add_comm (via Word.add_comm); there is no U32/Word add_assoc. Label normalization idempotence needs List.sort facts (sorted input is a fixpoint), and comparator totality needs String.is_le facts; Base states neither. Each law therefore first needs a lemma library proved from the Word level (add_assoc) or from List.sort's definition, which is the real size of this bead. Not started this session: the find-fix rounds (convergence) come first.
